core.description: SaaS CRUD/ops every PiB agent needs for day-to-day platform work

growth.description: First-class PiB product execution (social, SEO, ads, research, studio-adjacent)

system-auth.summary: How agents authenticate: user-delegation for interactive work; system key for cron only.

daily-workflow.summary: Safe natural-language start-day and end-day workflow with live workspace resolution, verification, durable context, and non-destructive git/process boundaries.

pib-bot-teams.summary: Teach every managed profile to address teammates with @handle, choose message_agent vs a direct room answer, honour 3-round / 10-message / 6-member caps, escalate with @user, and report delivery failures verbatim. Rooms persist via hermes-bots-groups / profiles.configure, not hosted groups.*.

pib-chat-canvas.summary: Teach agents to emit pib:chart, pib:mermaid, pib:math, and pib:html fences plus working-directory file references so Messages can render canvas parts.

interactive-project-planning.summary: Interview-first Decision Brief gate before substantive project execution and structured playbooks.

platform-ops.summary: Cross-cutting platform primitives: API keys, health, search, dashboard, activity, briefings, files, workspace folders, notifications, webhooks, comments. Split 2026-07-23 from the former mega-skill into agent-runtime-ops, platform-admin-users, and reports.

agent-runtime-ops.summary: Hermes profile links/controls, agent registry/admin, agent memory lookup/reindex, Loop Engine internals, runtime/provider health, linked computers.

platform-admin-users.summary: Platform Users (staff) super-admin CRUD, allowedOrgIds scoping, onboard/offboard.

reports.summary: Snapshot report CRUD + ad-hoc query reports (revenue, pipeline, outstanding, client-value, expense-summary, activity-summary, team-utilization).

video-editor-ops.summary: Editor projects/timelines, credit-metered render jobs, transcription/translation, TTS voiceover, 9:16 reframe, beat analysis, stock search/import, LUTs, templates, and the media-preview/proxy-ledger cache (route-mapped 2026-07-23; request/response shapes still to confirm).

creative-canvas-ops.summary: Creative canvas node graphs, generation runs, provider dispatch, exports, and BYOK provider connections (documented 2026-07-23; remaining route shapes still to confirm).

book-studio-ops.summary: Book studio chapters/pages content model, puzzle generation, print/ebook assembly, and the Creative Canvas production bridge (documented 2026-07-23; remaining route shapes still to confirm).

youtube-studio-ops.summary: YouTube Studio release pipeline and its Creative Canvas production bridge, sync-back, and scheduled publishing (documented 2026-07-23; remaining route shapes still to confirm).

conversations-runtime.summary: Stub: conversation/message runtime — CRUD, streaming lifecycle, attachments, models, agent-message ingestion. Not yet fully documented.

life-os-ops.summary: Personal Life OS — check-ins, AI coach workflow (with crisis safety boundary), experiments, reminder preferences/scheduling, weekly reviews, and admin-only data retention (route-mapped 2026-07-23; request/response shapes still to confirm).

llm-providers-ops.summary: LLM provider credential connections, device-code OAuth (xAI Grok, OpenAI Codex), and org/user-scoped Hermes VPS credential sync (route-mapped 2026-07-23; request/response shapes still to confirm).

workflow-graph-operator.summary: Day-to-day Workflow Graph operator: prod templates, start/list/inspect runs, opt-in Kanban sequencer usage. Residual/build stays on pib-workflow-graph-operations.

impeccable-design-discipline.summary: Impeccable design discipline (Apache 2.0 wrapper): named design command vocabulary, per-client design context (PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md equivalent in wiki), deterministic anti-slop detector as runnable check (npx impeccable detect --json, exit 0/2). Layer 1 — zero platform changes.

afterEveryWrite: Read back the created/updated resource by id
Assert success criteria from the skill (non-empty content, expected status, links)
Only then report URL/id to the human
On HTTP 4xx: print the JSON error field; do not create duplicate shells
